item.title: Kumano's Hot Springs: Yunomine, Kawayu and Watarase — Guide
item.description: The mountains around Kumano Hongu hold some of Japan’s most remarkable hot springs, long used by pilgrims to purify themselves before visiting the grand shrine. Yunomine Onsen, said to be the oldest hot spring in Japan at some 1,800 years, is a tiny village of steaming waters where Tsuboyu — a two-person rock bath in a hut over the stream — is the only bath in the world inscribed as a World Heritage Site.
